name: gridlabd
summary: Distribution power-system simulator for smart grid analysis, DER integration, and energy system modeling.
why_it_matters: GridLAB-D preserves specialized energy-simulation capability knowledge, but there is no active Vrooli scenario that justifies maintaining it as a supported resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs smart-grid or distribution-network simulation.
Operators want DER, load, or resilience modeling tied to local workflows.
The workflow depends on power-system analysis rather than generic simulation.

platform_support.notes: Scientific tooling and packaging vary by OS, and realistic usage depends on validated datasets and models rather than simple lifecycle support.

prerequisites: Defined artifact storage and result interpretation path
implementation_notes: Promotion should validate a specific energy-system workflow instead of generic solver support.
Keep data/model preparation separate from solver execution.
Do not claim broad platform support without tested installation paths.
operational_notes: Real value depends on trustworthy input models, not just binary availability.
Validation should include a known reference simulation.
Large result sets need explicit retention rules.
risks: Niche scientific tools become maintenance drag without active users.
Unsupported host installs are likely unless support scope stays narrow.
